items.ti: RT @realDonaldTrumpVivek Ramaswamy는 오하이오 주지사에 출마한 자신의 딸 에이미 액턴(Amy Acton)이 거짓말쟁이이며 훨씬 더 나쁘다고 말하는 어머니에 대한 매우 강력한 광고를 게재했습니다. The Press는 협력적이고 잘 조율된 공격을 통해 Vivek Ramaswamy가 "광고를 중단"하도록 하려고 노력하고 있습니다. 솔직히 말해서, 어머니가 딸에 대해 그런 식으로 말하는 사람은 누구나 일반적으로 딸이 주지사 사무실은 물론이고 사무실에서 봉사할 수 없게 될 것입니다. 전설적인 메리 맥레오드 트럼프(Mary MacLeod Trump)인 나의 어머니가 나에 대해 나쁜 말을 하면 가짜 뉴스가 그것을 과장할 것입니다. Dumocrats는 전적으로 지지할 것이며, 이는 10년의 광고, 아마도 세기의 광고로 기록될 것입니다! 광고 부문 우수상을 수상하게 됩니다. 그러나 위대한 주지사가 될 비벡이 이를 내놓았기 때문에 "인공" 뉴스는 공화당원에게 피해를 주고, 품위를 떨어뜨리고, 당혹스럽게 만들기 위해 그를 상대로 팀을 구성했습니다.
items.ti_en: RT @realDonaldTrumpVivek Ramaswamy put up a very powerful Ad about a mother saying that her daughter, Amy Acton, who is running for Governor of Ohio, is a liar, and much worse. The Press, in a concerted and well coordinated attack, is trying to get Vivek Ramaswamy to “take down the Ad.” Frankly, anybody whose mother spoke about a daughter in that way would normally lead to the daughter being precluded from serving in Office, let alone the Office of Governor. If my mother, the legendary Mary MacLeod Trump, said anything bad about me, the Fake News would play it up. The Dumocrats would be totally supportive, and it would go down as the Ad of the Decade — Maybe the Century! It would win Awards for Excellence in Advertising. But, because Vivek, who will be a GREAT Governor, put it out, the “Artificial” News has teamed up against him in order to damage, demean, and embarrass a Republican who is leading in the Polls. Our RINO Governor of Ohio, Mike DeWine, who I unfortunately helped get elected years ago, when he was losing by 16 points prior to my doing a Rally for him was, as usual, disloyal to the Republican Party. He strongly suggested that Vivek should, “take down the Ad.” He probably wants a Dumocrat to win, and certainly doesn’t want someone who will do a much better job than he is capable of doing. I suggested, on the other hand, that Vivek should keep it up, and let everyone listen to the mother of a defective, dishonest, and incapable Candidate, explain how the daughter is a DISASTER who, uncontrollably, lies, cheats, and steals! I only wish the mothers of my opponents would be so brave as to come forward and explain that their son or daughter is a liar, and much worse. That took a lot of courage to do but, essentially, what she was really doing was saving Ohio from making a truly horrible choice! The Press is trying to convince everyone that this Ad is bad, because it’s so good! Who wouldn’t use such an Ad? I would, it’s called, “hitting pay dirt.” The fact is, Lyin’ Amy Acton, who I’ve never even heard of before, has been lying about Vivek for the entire Campaign. I know the real Vivek, he is a brilliant and outstanding person who will cut Taxes, stop Crime and, MAKE OHIO GREAT AGAIN. He will be a fantastic Governor! President DONALD J. TRUMP
